history_summary: Add the Burkholderia cepacia species-reference GTDB correspondence
history_details: Preserve ZY1 and G1B stock identities, the 4:5 inoculation ratio, unresolved G1B native result/status and all source claims. Native species-ID correspondence for B. cepacia has 548 reference genomes and rounded fraction 0.93; no majority numerator or strain-specific assembly is inferred. Only taxonomy[0]'s GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. Existing abstract coverage, proposed complementarity, enzyme overlap and distinct endpoint/time limitations remain unchanged; no mutualism or resource-partitioning claim was added. Scoped database and provenance correction, not full scientific approval or corpus QC.
